theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pfi_refined_bilipschitz_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → Differentiable ℝ φ → ∃ (G : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (κ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ j, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G j)) ∧ (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < κ j) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ a ∈ A j, ∀ a' ∈ A j, κ j * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G j a - G j a'‖) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ a ∈ A j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G j) a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (G j) a)) ∧ (∀ j, MeasurableSet (G j '' A j)) ∧ (∀ j, G j '' A j ⊆ M) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (G i '' A i) (G j '' A j)) ∧ μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ j, G j '' A j) = 0 ∧ ∀ j, ((∃ κ' : ℝ, 0 < κ' ∧ ∀ a ∈ A j, ∀ a' ∈ A j, κ' * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖φ (G j a) - φ (G j a')‖) ∧ ∀ a ∈ A j, Injective (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ G j) a)) ∨ ∀ a ∈ A j, ¬ Injective (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ G j) a)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
